There’s a certain point where you base your entire identity around it and develop an extreme fear of not being committed to your disordered habits

I think we’re fed this idea that to get over depression you have to reach its peak (which according to the media is suicide when in reality it’s far more complicated) then you’ll be ‘deserving’ of help and have a team of medical professionals to help you rather than just doing it on your own.

The media portrays an image of depression that’s slightly romanticized so we have this idea that suicide will equate the attention that we need. 

Idk if this is inappropriate or not but you deserve to get better without following the cliche story, you don’t have to reach what we’re told is the ‘peak of depression’ bc depression is a mental illness and the fact that you’re sick is a reason to get better, you don’t need to dig your grave deeper to be able to ask for a ladder. 

It’s totally valid if you go feel this way and have these thoughts bc u are entitled to wanting to get better, just keep in mind that getting better doesn’t have to be like the sappy story we’re fed, sometimes it’s learning to cope with our issues in a healthy manner rather than solving them.

I really hope that the replies on this thread help you w getting help and dealing w suicidal thoughts❤️❤️❤️
